宇文至 Yuwen Zhi, courtesy name 宇文乾附 Yuwen Qianfu, 莒國公 Duke of Ju. Younger brother of Yuwen Hui. (周書/卷05) In 558 made 崇業公. (周書/卷11) 崇業公 until 561.8.1, on that day made 莒國公. (周書/卷05) 大將軍莒國 until 572.4.12, on that day executed. (周書/卷05)

宇文憲 Yuwen Xian, Xianbei name 宇文毗賀突 Yuwen Pihetu, 齊煬王 Prince Yang of Qi. Fifth son of Yuwen Tai. (周書/卷2) In 548 made 涪城縣開國公. (全後周文/卷12/後周周上柱國齊王憲神道碑) In 554.6.5 made 安城公. (周書/卷02) 大將軍、安城公 in 559.10.14, on that day made 益州總管 [until 562.12.12]. (周書/卷04) 安城公 until 559.11.2, on that day made 齊國公. (周書/卷04) In 564.8.24 made 雍州牧. (周書/卷05) In 568.5.28 made 大司馬. 李懷柔 Li Huairou. Eldest son of Li Xiaogong. (新唐書/卷072上)

路元伯 Lu Yuanbo or 路承伯 Lu Chengbo. Sixth generation descendant of Lu Zuan. (元和姓纂/卷8) 青州别駕 during Sui. (元和姓纂/卷8 and 全唐文補遺/第1輯/大唐故朝議郎行蒲州桑泉縣丞輕車度尉路府君墓誌)

沈皇后 Empress Shen. Daughter of Shen Xie. Married 宇文邕. (大唐故杭州錢塘縣丞沈府君墓誌銘) As Empress Ashina was an Empress between 568 and 578, Empress Shen had to be an Empress before her. Yong requested marriage in 565, so by that year Empress Shen either died or was demoted to a concubine.
麹乾固，麹宝茂子。

慕容三藏/慕容叁藏 Murong Sanzang or 慕容建中 Murong Jianzhong. Second son of Murong Shaozong. (北齊書/卷20) At some point made 晉州刺史. (墓誌) In 581 made 吳州刺史. (隋書/卷65) In 587 made 某州刺史. (墓誌) In 589 made 涼州道黜陟大使.
